_comment: Manual overrides for Sinnoh. Auto-extraction (pull-maps.mjs) covers the rest. Reasons: no distinct DP highlight map (wayward-cave shares Route 206, victory-road shares the Pokemon League map); map-revision mismatch → empty/bogus/full-map diff (hearthome-city, oreburgh-city, eterna-forest, route-228, route-205 — their highlight PNGs are a different rendering than the base group, so hand-anchored against accurate auto neighbors); or a shape/size tweak the auto bbox got wrong (route-212 authored as its true L, route-205 as the Eterna<->Floaroma corridor instead of one merged box, turnback-cave nudged lower+bigger per Paul). Tile space, 27x21 grid, 8px tiles.
